title: Listening
summary: A song to understand by ear, then the examiner asks what was heard.
description: Understanding real Polish sung at speed, which reading does not train.

requirements.text: A song has at most one listening lesson; asking for another gives the one it has.

A listening lesson's objectives follow its complexity: the chorus and familiar words; from medium also translating a line and filling a missing word; at high also the grammar of a line and retelling the song.
A listening lesson made without a complexity is of medium complexity.
A listening lesson is filed in the course it is given, else in the song's course, else in `term.other-lessons`.
The examiner is given the song's lyrics and asks about what was heard, quoting at most one short line per question.
A listening lesson plays a song with the lyrics hidden unless asked for, then the examiner asks about what was heard; the song can be replayed during the conversation.
A song the tutor makes gets a listening lesson unless the tutor opts out, and any song's page can start one.
